name: ModelVariant103_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant103_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a fan of triangles grows out of the followed slot part, holds, then swells and fades while the screen flashes white, four pairs of blades spin open from the centre and eight rotated arcs of wobbling textured strips spread around it); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the fan and strips and packs one texture image, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 during the delay, the growth and the hold, 2 once the strips have faded and 1 in between; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-120 and 250 images build it from the same source with the PAL flash height and the US data layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
